newsitem.title: USA: Presstek to ship product in balance of 97.
newsitem.headline: Presstek to ship product in balance of 97.

text.p: Presstek Inc said Thursday that it did not ship its PEARLsetter product during the second quarter, but expects to resume filling orders during the balance of the year.
PEARLsetter, a plate-setter printing product, instead underwent revisions and enhancements during the second quarter. The company continued taking orders for the product.
The company said the temporary halt in shipping is not expected to have a materially adverse effect on its overall revenues for the year.
Presstek said the development work is complete and the upgraded PEARLsetter is being put into production.
A company spokesman said the product pulls in a "very small fraction" of Presstek's earnings and is not considered a key product at this time.
